body:
To get you in context, I had just had my heart broken. The day before the experience I wrote on my diary that I felt fear, I was afraid of being already dead inside, and fantasized about exiting the Earth through space... Yep, I was kind of depressed and carried away by my emotions.
My first mushroom experience was as follows:
We were in the house of this guy I had just met. Someone talked about knowing someone who had mushrooms, so we called and got them. We had been smoking weed that day, but it had been at least 2 or 3 hours since last smoke, and I didn't smoke so much, so I wasn't high.
We had been smoking weed that day, but it had been at least 2 or 3 hours since last smoke, and I didn't smoke so much, so I wasn't high.
We ate some muffins and chocolate bars before taking the shrooms.
I took first two grams that I already had, and took the other gram 30 minutes after. At 1 hour more or less after the first intake I started seeing the colors way more saturated, more beautiful, more alive. I was sitting on an armchair, and my two friends and their friends were watching a movie. Then faces started to be more elves-like, and more pretty too. I had my computer, so I started listening to Romance to the Grave, by Broken Social Scene. I played it thousand of times, with headphones. My hands vibe, and they are also beautiful. I live the music. My body feels faint. I think that this would be perfect to make love, with this music. I saw my friends watching tv, doing nothing, I thought they were zombies: How could they be there, so passive, silent, just shallowing all they threw on tv! (I don't like tv, and I don't own a tv, but I do like good movies and they were watching a good one. Even though I found it the most stupid thing on Earth.) Two more people came, and they just sat down on the floor and watched tv. I wrote on my computer: 'They are all sitting on the couch, even on the floor. All of them watching tv.
Engrossed. Some of them have just arrived and they haven't seen three fourth parts of the movie. But they don't seem to care. They take a seat and watch. All with the same serious face. No emotions on their expressions. And I'm seating too, and I'm watching it. It was ridiculous. I turned back to watch to my friend who also took psilocybin, and he was still watching tv, so serious.
I decided to close my eyes and let my self go through the music. As I closed my eyes I entered in a complete different space, infinite space, where the music was colors in movement, and I felt flowing with them, floating and dancing, but not my body, I didn't think on my body (if I had one). I kept on listening to that song, with my eyes closed, and felt pure ecstasy. Yes, I was pure ecstasy. And that song was heavenly. At some point I wrote: 'The important stuff is what we have lived. We shouldn't try to underestimate what it was. But we shouldn't believe on those feelings 100%'. ??
After a while my friends told me we were leaving (I had told my friend J that I preferred to move to his house a while ago). I got up, and started packing my things in my back pack. The cable of the computer charger was difficult for me. I felt down in a graceful way, and started laughing to my impossibility of doing anything. My friends helped me, and D (who had not taken shrooms) drove J and me to J's house. I was seated on the back part of the car, and the external world seemed like a movie of Tim Burton (it was night time). The car seemed huge, I felt I had a bunch of space surrounding me, and I felt presences seated next to me. I was a little freaked out, but I knew I had taken a drug, so it was ok, and I role-played a bit pretending they were there and I smiled.
Finally we got to J's house, and as soon as I got to his room, I started playing the same BSS song I had played all the time at the other guy's house. I felt so happy of being there, cause I felt much more comfortable being with my friends. After a couple of minutes D left us both tripping alone.
We went to the bed and lay down, listening to the music (BSS and Explosions in the Sky). I kept my eyes closed and flowed again in the infinite universe with the music and the colors. Pure ecstasy. My friend J, who is experienced in drugs and can be very functional on them (I would have never thought on doing anything else than being there on the bed with closed eyes and being ecstasy), he asked me if I wanted to smoke weed. My first response was a vague no, and I kept of closing my eyes and going to that other universe. He asked a while later, and after another 15 minutes? he prepared a bowl and smoked. I was not functional to the world at all, I almost couldn't/didn't feel like communicate. Finally I smoked too, I don't remember if one or two hits. I kept on being pure ecstasy, elevating myself with the music in that whole universe. I even saw like a white Jesus-like light at the top of that universe (I'm an atheist, so are my parents, but my country religion is Catholicism). But then the song Welcome, Ghosts, by Explosions in the Sky got to its 'dark'? point and I felt all that elevation I was having coming down, down, down.
I was falling into an absolute darkness. I realized I was starting what I heard so many times: a bad trip. I opened up my eyes, and got seated on the bed. I felt anxious. I staggered to the restroom to get some water. I felt a profound fear. I was gonna die. I didn't want to tell anything to my friend, who was enjoying on the bed. I changed the music, but it didn't work. Fear and anxiety in a deep level. I was completely overwhelmed. It went on, and I struggled against it. At some point I realized that I was not physically going to die. Then I felt so lost in space and time. I thought I would never find myself again. But then I realized that it was only emotions, and I abandoned myself to them. Emotions cannot make you anything whenever you realize you are feeling them. So that was it: that terrible and huge ego of mine was the one who was afraid of death. And I was not my ego per se. So I embraced her death. I let myself go with all that pain and sorrow. I was burning in a black fire, seated on the floor. There was not more resistance, and I started enjoying it. I let my ego die, and I felt good doing so. The bad trip was over, but I wanted to kill all the rest of that asshole that creates so many problems on my self-esteem. So I squeezed my soul until there was nothing else, no more ego there. Black fire went up, disappearing.
It was then when I started feeling a profound feeling of infinite and unconditional acceptance for myself, I felt pure love for myself, for the first time in my life. And then I started elevating in pink bubbles and hearts that gave me the heat of love. I cried, but it was pure joy. It was mystic. It was beauty in pure state. LOVE. I felt blessed, and I felt so thankful for having that experience. I kept on this mood, and danced with the music that made me reborn (Retreat! Retreat!, by 65daysofstatic). I was the music again, and there were no limits.
At some point I got up and saw my reflection on the mirror. I couldn't stop looking at me. I felt love, unconditional love and acceptance. I saw all the beauty in me. I was so pretty, and I kept looking at me. My friend J told me 'Don't get lost on your reflection', but I looked at him, smiled, and looked at me again. I saw/felt myself as a christian virgin, with a headscarf. I was beauty and pure. Then my skin started to fall apart, just in the right side of my face. And I realized that, it didn't matter that my body was not beautiful, I still saw my real essence and that was the important matter, and I was precious. I danced more, and then looked again at the mirror. My hair was a mess, and I had it on my face. I saw myself being a widow, a widow of my ego. And I smiled to my reflection, feeling liberated.
The effects started to disappear smoothly and in a mellow way. I was exhausted. We went to the living room and started watching a terrible Mexican soap opera for a while. Then we went to sleep, and I had no problem on sleeping the whole night at once, pleasantly.
---------------------------------------------------------------------
That experience changed my life in a very positive way. For the first time in my life, I accepted myself without judgment, and from emptying myself from the black shit I had inside, I made space for the love to fill me. This experience had a long-lasting effect, and brought me to have a much richer and spiritual life. Now I am not an atheist anymore, and I'd say that my life improved very very much thanks to mushrooms. Although they didn't fix anything, they gave me another perspective that was much more positive for my well-being, and since then my mind is broader, I have much more self-acceptance and I am more in control of my life.
